attractions_search = get_results_from_cache(key="Attraction search results in Fresno. attraction type(s): [Scenic]")

# Search for hotels in Fresno with specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="Fresno",
    checkin_date=["August 17, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["August 20, 2025"],
    num_people=3,
    stars=[4],
    budget=65,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="Fresno hotel search results", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on amenities (pool and room service)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="Fresno filtered hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest scenic attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="Fresno nearest scenic attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output the query summary
print("No planning needed")
